purpose: Separate pre-commit privacy review of the newly supplied public CI artifact; not inherited from prior source-bundle reviews.
method: UTF-8 text inspection with credential/path/contact/URL patterns and context review of matching public identity and policy diagnostics; secret-like matches are not printed.

findings.email_disposition: Only the repository author's already-public GitHub noreply address, repeated in author/committer metadata; retained.
findings.other_retained_metadata: Public GitHub identity, runner/tool versions, SHA-256 object IDs, GitHub runner and temporary fixture paths; policy diagnostics do not contain full fixture credentials.

disposition: No redaction required by this review; keep the original ZIP and reports byte-for-byte for local evidence commit.
limits: Pattern scanning and contextual inspection are not complete DLP, a third-party audit, or proof of the absence of every possible sensitive value. No full project test run or public push was performed.
